description: This file defines the 'User' entity class for a Java-based backend, representing users in a learning management system. It includes fields for user attributes like email, password hash, display name, creation timestamp, and enabled status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Entity class representing a user in the system, with fields for id, email, password hash, display name, enabled status, and creation time.

methods.name: User(String email, String passwordHash, String displayName)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new User instance with email, password hash, and display name.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: getEmail()
methods.description: Returns the email of the user.

methods.name: isEnabled()
methods.description: Returns whether the user account is enabled.

methods.name: getCreatedAt()
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the user.
